messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi! I’m having issues with my mobile data—it keeps stopping or is very slow. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone while I’m abroad in France. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I hope you can help me fix this as soon as possible!

I can help you troubleshoot your mobile data issues while you’re abroad. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide either:

- The phone number associated with your line,
- Your full name and date of birth, or
- Your customer ID (if you have it)?

Once I have this information, I’ll check your account and guide you through the steps to resolve your mobile data problem.
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next to fix my mobile data.

Thank you for providing your information. I see your line is active, roaming is enabled, and you are on the Premium Plan with a 15GB monthly data limit. You have used about 8.7GB so far, so you still have data available.

To help resolve your slow or unstable mobile data while abroad, I’ll need you to perform a few checks on your phone. Are you ready to follow some quick steps? If so, please let me know, and I’ll guide you through the process to diagnose and improve your connection.
Yes, I’m ready to follow your steps. Please let me know what you’d like me to check or do first.

Great! Let’s start by checking your phone’s current network and data status. 

Please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- What network type is displayed (e.g., 5G, 4G, 3G, E, H+)
- If you see any icons like Airplane Mode, Data Saver, or VPN
- Your current signal strength (number of bars or description)

If you’re not sure how to check, just describe what you see at the top of your phone’s screen. This will help me determine the next best step to improve your mobile data speed.
(guides the customer through a device action)
Status Bar: ✈️ Airplane Mode | 🔋 80%
My phone’s status bar currently shows Airplane Mode is on, and the battery is at 80%. I don’t see any network type or signal bars at the moment—just the airplane icon. What should I do next?

Your phone is currently in Airplane Mode, which disables all wireless connections, including mobile data. To restore your mobile data connection, please turn off Airplane Mode. 

Once you’ve done that, check if your phone shows any network type (like 4G or 5G) and signal bars. Let me know what you see after turning off Airplane Mode, and we’ll continue troubleshooting if needed.
(guides the customer through a device action)

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now, my status bar shows excellent signal strength with 5G and data enabled. What would you like me to do next?

That’s a great sign! Your phone now has excellent signal strength and is connected to 5G with data enabled. 

To confirm your mobile data speed and ensure everything is working as expected, please run a speed test on your phone. Let me know the result (download speed and quality, if shown). This will help us determine if your connection is now excellent or if further steps are needed.
(guides the customer through a device action)
Speed test failed: No Connection.

I tried running a speed test, but it failed and said there’s no connection. Even though the status bar shows 5G with excellent signal, it looks like mobile data still isn’t working properly. What should I do next?

Thank you for letting me know. Since your status bar shows 5G and excellent signal but the speed test reports no connection, let’s check if your mobile data is actually enabled in your phone’s settings.

Please check your phone’s settings and confirm:
- Is mobile data turned ON?
- Is Data Saver mode enabled?
- Are you connected to a VPN?

Let me know what you find, and I’ll guide you through the next steps based on your answers.
(guides the customer through a device action)

Airplane Mode: OFF
SIM Card Status: active
Cellular Connection: connected
Cellular Signal: excellent
Cellular Network Type: 5G
Mobile Data Enabled: Yes
Data Roaming Enabled: No
Wi-Fi Radio: OFF
Wi-Fi Connected: No
Data Saver mode is OFF.
VPN is turned OFF.

I checked my phone’s settings, and here’s what I found:
- Mobile data is turned ON.
- Data Saver mode is OFF.
- VPN is OFF.
- Also, data roaming is currently turned OFF.

What should I check or try next?

Since you are abroad in France, data roaming must be turned ON for your mobile data to work outside your home network. Please enable data roaming in your phone’s settings.

After turning on data roaming, try running the speed test again and let me know if your mobile data starts working or if you still experience issues.
(guides the customer through a device action)

Data Roaming is now ON.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
(guides the customer through a device action)
Speed Test Result: 275.00 Mbps (Excellent). Connection is very fast.

I enabled data roaming and ran another speed test. The result was 275 Mbps, which is listed as excellent and the connection is very fast. My mobile data seems to be working perfectly now. Thanks for your help!

I’m glad to hear your mobile data is now working perfectly and you’re getting excellent speeds! If you have any other questions or need further assistance while abroad, feel free to ask. Safe travels and enjoy your time in France!
Thank you so much! I appreciate your help in getting this sorted out. Everything’s working great now. Have a wonderful day! ###STOP###
Post-call QA note: issue confirmed resolved during the call; environment checks passed.
